features.what: State halo: shape rendering geometricPrecision, so #statesHalo and the per-state clip paths are drawn
Options > Rendering reads Best quality, so the zoom styling keeps scaling the halo (the preamble matches the select to the file)
Coastline with auto-filter=1 and the drop-shadow filter active at k=1 (switches at k 1.5 / 2.6)
Lakes spread over the six stock groups (freshwater, salt, sinkhole, frozen, lava, dry)
Regiments: plain, rotated (4 land, 2 naval), naval, data:image PNG and SVG icons, emoji icons
Markers: every pin shape with colour emoji (ZWJ, skin tone, flag), data:image PNG and SVG icons, one pinned, with notes
A drawn legend (states, two columns) at a non-default data-x/data-y
All four measurers: ruler (the default one plus a polyline), opisometer, route opisometer, planimeter
Compass rose on
Scale bar on
Hex grid with a dash pattern, round caps and a pattern offset (patternTransform scale/translate)
Coordinate graticule and labels
Texture layer with a same-origin image
Runtime-only #debug content (route control point, highlight)
Ice: glaciers and icebergs, three icebergs and one glacier dragged (offset transform)
Zones using all 42 stock hatches (hatch0..hatch41) plus four solid-colour zones
Temperature, precipitation, population, goods and markets layers populated and visible
Cells layer (raster of the cell mesh); drawn by the preamble, not carried in the file
Fog focus on two states through fog() with the #fogging veil on
Vignette on
Curved state labels, straight burg labels, custom labels with textPaths (straight, quadratic, cubic, multi-line, letter-spaced, haloed group)
Emblems (state, province and burg coats of arms)
Trade layer on with markets and deals (the animation starts by itself on load)
Animated trade markers present a moment after load

preamble: await __parity.preamble() after loading: draws the cells layer (not stored in the file) and #debug, then wait ~2 s for the trade animation to start
notes: Header date and map id are normalised (see PARITY_CONFIG), so the sha is stable across rebuilds on one host.
Fonts: every non-local request is aborted, so label and legend metrics use the host's fallback fonts. The same file loaded with web fonts keeps its stored geometry.
The cells layer is a 0.8 MB raster the app redraws on toggle; it is left off in the file and drawn by __parity.preamble() to stay under the size budget.
